correctness.rationale: Each undirected edge has an independent Poisson communication rate equal to the sum of endpoint inverse degrees. Competing rates h and 1 give exact first-event probabilities. Conditional branches yield ordinary-leaf exponential maxima and the distinguished-leaf Laplace correction F_m. Exact algebra gives the polynomial difference. P(6)=400, P′(6)=1100 and P″(m)>0 for m>=6, Q(m)>0 for m>=2. Four rational boundary values settle m=2..5. F_m<=1/(m-1) proves the positive 1/3 limit. The complete labeled-state first-step solver independently reproduces 20 graph expectations (m=2..11) without relying on the closed form; product identities through m=14 passed. Infinite claim uses the analytic proof, not enumeration.
